questions.q: Determine the mass of the heaviest uniform bar that can be supported in the position shown below if the breaking strength of the horizontal cable attached at C is 15 kg wt. Neglect friction.
In the following figure, a light rod is in equilibrium horizontally. Find the magnitude of $f-k$.

ABCD is a non-uniform rod that rests horizontally on two smooth supports at B and C such that $AB=6$ cm and $CD=7$ cm and the point of action of its weight divides it in a ratio of 2: 3 from its 'A' end. It's found that if a weight of a magnitude of 120 kg wt is suspended from the end 'A' or a weight of 180 kg wt is suspended from the end 'D', the rod is about to rotate. Find the distance between the two supports.
The bob of a pendulum 90 cm long swings in a 15-cm arc as shown below. Find the angle $\theta$, in radians, through which it swung.
A fan turns at a rate of 900 rpm. Find the angular speed at any point on the fans blades. Find the tangential speed of the tip of a blade if the distance from the center to the tip is 20 cm.

A Wheel of 40 cm radius rotates on a stationary axle. It is uniformly sped up from rest to a speed of 900 rpm in a time of 20 s. Find the constant angular acceleration of the wheel and the tangential acceleration of a point on its rim.

A car has wheels of radius 30 cm. It starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to a speed of $15~ms^{-1}$ in a time of 8 seconds. Find the angular acceleration of its wheels and the number of rotations one wheel makes in this time.
The spin-dryer of a washing machine revolving at 900 rpm slows down uniformly to 300 rpm while making 50 revolutions. Find the time required to turn through these 50 revolutions.
A wheel of mass 6 kg and radius of gyration 40 cm is rotating at 300 rpm. Find its moment of inertia.
An airplane propeller has a mass of 70 kg and a radius of gyration of 75 cm. Find its moment of inertia. How large of a torque is needed to give it an angular acceleration of 4 revs $s^{-2}$?
A constant force of 40 N is applied tangentially to the rim of a wheel with a radius of 20 cm. The wheel has a moment of inertia of $30~kg~m^{2}$. Find the angular speed after 4 seconds from rest.
The wheel on a grinder is a uniform 90-kg disc with a radius of 8 cm. It coasts uniformly to rest from 1400 rpm in a time of 35 seconds. How large a friction torque slows its motion?
A flywheel has a moment of inertia of $3.8~kg~m^{2}$. What constant torque is required to increase its frequency from 2 revs $s^{-1}$ to $5~rev~s^{-1}$ in 6 revolutions?

A man stands on a freely rotating platform with his arm extended. His rotation frequency is 0.25 $s^{-1}$, but when he draws his arms in, his frequency is 0.81 rev $s^{-1}$. Find the ratio of his moment of inertia in the first case to that in the second.

A disk of moment of inertia $I_{1}$ is rotating freely with angular speed $\omega_{1}$. When a second, non-rotating disk with a moment of inertia $I_{2}$ is dropped on it, the two then rotate as a unit. Find the final angular speed of the two-disk system.
A wheel of mass 6 kg and radius of gyration 40 cm is rotating at 300 rpm. Find its moment of inertia and its rotational K.E.
A 500-gm sphere of 7-cm radius spins at $30~rev~s^{-1}$. Find its K.E. given $I=\frac{2}{5}Mr^{2}$
As shown in the following figure, a mass $m=400$ g hangs from the rim of a wheel of radius $r=15$ cm. When released from rest, the mass falls 2.0 m in 6.5 s. Find the moment of inertia of the wheel.

A body of mass 2 kg, initially at rest on a smooth horizontal plane, is subjected to a horizontal force of magnitude $\frac{1}{2v+1}$ N. Where v is the velocity of the object $(v>0)$. Find the time when the velocity is $1~ms^{-1}$.

A body of mass 2 kg, initially at rest on a smooth horizontal plane, is subjected to a horizontal force of magnitude $\frac{1}{2v+1}$ N. Where v is the velocity of the object $(v>0)$ Find the displacement when the velocity is $1~ms^{-1}$.
If $F=3t+1$, $m=4$ kg and the body is initially at rest at point O. Find v when $t=2$ seconds.
If $F=3t+1$, $m=4$ kg and the body is initially at rest at point O. Find s when $t=2$ seconds.

A particle moves in the direction of the positive x-axis under the influence of a varying force F = 0.2x N Where x is the distance of the particle from the origin in meters. Find the work on the particle by F when the particle moves from x = 1 to x = 5.

A body of mass 3 kg moves along a curve under the action of a resultant force $\vec{F}$ in newtons. At time t the position vector $\vec{r}$ of the body is $\vec{r} = 2t\vec{i} + t^3\vec{j} + t^2\vec{k}$. Calculate the work done by $\vec{F}$ between t = 0 and t = 2.

A body of mass 3 kg moves along a curve under the action of a resultant force $\vec{F}$ in newtons. At time t the position vector $\vec{r}$ of the body is $\vec{r} = 2t\vec{i} + t^3\vec{j} + t^2\vec{k}$. Calculate the power done by $\vec{F}$ at t = 2.
